text:
matt-ops: Heads up, EU-West pool reporting slow node joins after last night's infra sweep. Nodes spin on 'fetching auth' then timeout. ~50% of new nodes stuck.

reza-sre: What's the exact error? paste from agent logs.

matt-ops: log excerpt: `2026-04-02T03:12:10Z ERROR auth fetch failed: kms:AccessDenied (grant missing); audit-shipper: route lookup failed for srv-audit.eu-west.internal`

tara-sec: We tightened audit-log retention and removed an old SRV alias that we thought was unused. The SRV change may have orphaned the shipper route; also we scoped a KMS grant to resources with tag env=prod only during the sweep.

audit-bot: shipper: DNS lookup for srv-audit.eu-west.internal -> NXDOMAIN. PUT /eu-west/logs/nodejoin 503 (no route)

amelia-ml: Impact: training and inferencing jobs queued on EU pool. Two large fine-tunes paused; fallback to us-west increased egress.

cost-bot: Alert: cross-region fallback egress estimate +$3.8k/day if EU remains degraded. GPU pool size down 46% (expected 13 -> 7).

reza-sre: Possible mitigations? 1) revert SRV change (restore alias) 2) widen KMS grant tag filter 3) temporarily add shipper DNS override to /etc/hosts on nodes. Least risky?

tara-sec: Restoring SRV alias is low blast and quick. Widening KMS grant is more sensitive but doable. Hosts override is brittle at scale. I'll roll the SRV alias back now and validate grants.

matt-ops: Rolling SRV alias back. Command (internal):
```
nsupdate <<EOF
server dns1.eu-west.internal
zone eu-west.internal
update add srv-audit 60 IN SRV 10 5 443 audit-proxy.eu-west.internal.
send
EOF
```

audit-bot: DNS: srv-audit.eu-west.internal -> audit-proxy.eu-west.internal (restored)

reza-sre: Requeued a canary: node-join-12 succeeded. But I still see a couple of join failures with kms:AccessDenied. Looks like the grant tag scoping still blocks the shipper role when it proxies on behalf of ephemeral nodes.

tara-sec: The audit-shipper principal wasn't tagged with env=prod because it runs across prod+staging. I can create a constrained grant that permits `Encrypt,Decrypt` for the shipper role ARN directly. That should be low risk.

amelia-ml: Note: when nodes come back there's a risk of thundering herd on model blob pulls. Can we gate restarts?

matt-ops: We'll stagger node reconverge and throttle initial pulls via holdoff script.

tara-sec: Creating grant now:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/node-artifacts-eu --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-shipper --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

tara-sec: Grant created and propagated.

audit-bot: shipper: PUT /eu-west/logs/nodejoin 200 (ok)

reza-sre: Pool recovery check: 13/13 nodes healthy, canary joins stable.

cost-bot: Cost projection normalized.

matt-ops: Follow-ups: - add SRV alias check into deploy CI for audit-shipper rollouts - include shipper role in KMS grant test matrix (tag and direct grant) - add a soft throttle to node bootstrap to avoid cluster thundering herd on model pulls.

tara-sec: Will add post-deploy smoke: DNS SRV + KMS grant verification from shipper principal. Also open a ticket to review tag-only grant patterns.

amelia-ml: I'll pace job restarts over 4 hours to reduce pressure.

matt-ops: Closing thread, resolved. Ping if any regressions.
